martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_bunc:
The Negation of The Thread of The Starbuncle. 
Increases Attack Speed.
martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_gole:
The Negation of The Thread of The Amethyst Golem. 
Increases Attack Knockback by 50% per level.
martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_rege:
The Negation of The Thread of Mana Capacity. 
Increases the users Mana Regen by 10%% per level.
martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_spel:
The Negation of The Thread of Spell Power. 
Increases Strength by a flat amount.
martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_ward:
The Negation of The Thread of Warding. 
Increases the users Armor and Armor toughness.
martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_whir:
The Negation of The Thread of The Whirlisprig. 
Increases all incoming healing by 11% per level.
martial_ars.perk_desc.origin_thread_wixi:
The Negation of The Thread of The Wixie. 
decreases the duration of negative effects by 10% per level.
martial_ars.ritual_desc.ritual_repair: Uses a moderate amount of source per second to repair anything with durability placed on adjacent arcane pedestals, Unless you augment it with earth and air essence in which case it will instead apply an effect in a wide area that repairs tools in equipment slots  (armor slots off hand and main hand) though at halved efficiency. fire essence can be used to increase throughput consuming more source for more durability per second.
martial_ars.spear.invalid: Hey uh, take the form glyph off your spell and try again.
tooltip.martial_ars.mages_shades.base: Shades for one of great endurance. These give Mage Sight when worn.
tooltip.martial_ars.mistbreaker.base: Commonly worn by the Mistkin. This ring conceals and empowers you while you are within the embrace of a mist cloud. Offering Speed and Strength.
tooltip.martial_ars.mushroom_wand.shift: Made for a really fungi (Coytn) who has also released the mod Mycomancy and yes, you ARE being compelled to check it out. Unfortunately there isn't mushroom for the list of errors you have helped me fix. So I will have to spore you the details.
tooltip.martial_ars.source_ingot.tooltip: Made from using source to force Iron to resonate with the trace amounts of Magenisium already present in the ingot.
